record.question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are eight girls who are sitting around a octagonal enclosure facing the centre. B is sitting between G and D. H is third to the left of B and second to the right of a. C is sitting between A and G, B and E are not sitting opposite to each other, who is sitting third to the left of D?
record.explanation: Placing B at position 0 with H at +3 and A at +5 gives G at position 7 and D at position 1, and C at 6. Only E at position 2 and F at position 4 satisfy the non-opposite condition, so the person third to the left of D (position 4) is F.
